svg.title: K25 · The autoscaler that shrugs: the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 25: load Pod (keeps the app, busy on purpose); Service showdown (one stable address); Pod showdown (1 replica, Cats vs Dogs). Also: metrics-server (measures CPU, and memory); HPA (scale 1 to 4, at 50% CPU). Your mission: Traffic is pouring in. Why does the autoscaler shrug?

svg.text: Traffic is pouring in. The autoscaler shrugs: "unknown".
